tools.name: ask_user
tools.summary: Ask the user a question in chat and WAIT for their answer: the whole agent pauses until they reply.

tools.name: edit_file
tools.summary: Replace one exact piece of text in a file with new content.

tools.name: get_scrollback
tools.summary: Deep-capture the user's visible terminal scrollback (last N lines including the live screen) to see what happened there.

tools.name: host_scan
tools.summary: Read-only discovery pass over this machine to draft its architecture map.

tools.name: read_file
tools.summary: Read a file (plain text, truncated to ~64k chars).

tools.name: reload
tools.summary: Re-read your configuration, custom instructions, agents, and skills from disk.

tools.name: session_list
tools.summary: List PAST chat sessions (this user's earlier conversations with you), newest first: use it to see what was discussed and to pick a session to open with session_view.

tools.name: session_search
tools.summary: Search PAST chat sessions (this user's earlier conversations with you) by content: useful when they reference something discussed before, or when checking whether a question/decision has come up already.

tools.name: session_view
tools.summary: View the messages of one PAST chat session, in order (oldest first).

tools.name: shell_background
tools.summary: Run a shell command in a hidden background shell (NOT the user's visible terminal: the user sees NOTHING that happens here).

tools.name: shell_session
tools.summary: Type into the user's VISIBLE terminal: their live shell session, the pane they are looking at.

tools.name: skill_view
tools.summary: Read a skill's full procedure by name (progressive disclosure).

tools.name: skills_list
tools.summary: List the available skills with their one-line descriptions.

tools.name: view_image
tools.summary: Look at an image FILE on this machine (png, jpeg, webp, gif): screenshots, diagrams, photos.

tools.name: write_file
tools.summary: Create or overwrite a file with content.
